title: Geomagic Control X workflows and connector status
description: Explore Geomagic Control X workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Geomagic Control X

Geomagic Control X supports dimensional inspection and comparison of scan data against design intent.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Align scan and nominal data

Begin with the selected scan or measured data, nominal CAD reference and coordinate basis. In the intended Geomagic Control X preview, align scan and nominal data; the visible result is a proposed alignment between measured data and nominal CAD. Review units, alignment strategy, reference identity and alignment error before accepting or exporting it.

Build an inspection plan

Use the measured data and nominal CAD reference. In the intended Geomagic Control X preview, build an inspection plan; the visible result is a proposed inspection routine with selected measurements, scan-to-CAD comparisons and tolerance definitions. Review data quality, alignment strategy, measurement scope and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Report dimensional deviation

Start from the reviewed measurements and scan-to-CAD comparisons. In the intended Geomagic Control X preview, report dimensional deviation; the visible result is a proposed dimensional-deviation report tied to the measured data and nominal CAD reference. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and alignment before accepting or exporting it.
